column1: How does a filter-aware modal navigation engine determine the subset of projects to cycle through?
column2: It queries PORTFOLIO_DATA against state.activeFilter, returning all projects if 'all', or only items where item.category === state.activeFilter.

column1: Why is stepping through a filtered array subset better UX than cycling through the entire unfiltered collection?
column2: It respects the user's explicit browsing intent (e.g., inspecting only Apparel) without forcing them to view unrelated categories.

column1: What is the mathematical modulo formula to step to the next item in an array of length N?
column2: (currentIndex + 1) % N

column1: What is the mathematical modulo formula in JavaScript to step to the previous item in an array of length N, supporting circular wrap-around?
column2: ((currentIndex - 1) % N + N) % N

column1: Why is Array.prototype.findIndex() used instead of Array.prototype.indexOf() when finding an object in an array?
column2: findIndex() allows evaluating a predicate function (e.g., p => p.id === activeId) rather than strict object reference equality.

column1: What does Array.prototype.findIndex() return if no element satisfies the testing function?
When stepping to a new case study inside an open modal, what state variables must be updated?
column2: state.activeModalId is set to the new project ID, and state.activeSlideIndex is reset to 0.

column1: How does the modal WhatsApp CTA dynamically synchronize with the newly focused case study?
column2: Its href is regenerated with generateWhatsAppUrl() using the new project's title and dataset.projectId is updated.

column1: Why should project counter text (e.g. 'Project 2 of 6') use aria-live="polite"?
column2: To inform screen reader users of their updated position in the collection without interrupting other announcements.

column1: How should previous and next case study navigation buttons be labeled for assistive technology?
column2: With dynamic aria-label attributes containing the adjacent project titles (e.g., 'Previous case study: CYMA HOMES').

column1: What should happen to previous and next case study navigation buttons if the filtered subset has only 1 project?
column2: The buttons should be disabled (disabled = true) or the navigation bar hidden (display: none).

column1: Why is centralized event delegation advantageous when handling 'prev-project' and 'next-project' button clicks?
column2: Clicks on nested SVG icons or text spans bubble to [data-action], eliminating individual event listener attachments.

column1: How does the application distinguish keyboard arrow navigation for image slides versus case study navigation?
column2: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigate image slides within the current project; Alt+ArrowLeft/Alt+ArrowRight or P/N navigate adjacent case studies.

column1: Why must keyboard shortcuts check if document.activeElement is an INPUT or TEXTAREA before executing?
column2: To prevent accidental navigation when a user is typing inside a text form field.

column1: What happens to the multi-image slider when a user navigates to a new case study in the modal?
column2: renderModalSlider(project) is called, clearing old slide DOM nodes, mounting new slides and dots, and resetting translateX to 0%.

column1: In terms of memory management, why is updating existing modal DOM nodes better than destroying and re-creating the entire modal element?
column2: Reusing persistent DOM nodes avoids garbage collection churn and layout recalculations for the modal overlay and backdrop.

column1: Why is encodeURIComponent() used when generating dynamic WhatsApp URLs for case study titles?
column2: To escape spaces and special characters (like '&', '+', '?') into valid RFC 3986 percent-encoded strings.

column1: How does the application prevent runtime errors if an unknown project ID is passed to openModal()?
column2: It guards the lookup with a check if project exists, logs a warning, and returns early without altering DOM or state.

column1: What role does lastFocusedElement play when a user navigates across multiple projects before closing the modal?
column2: It remembers the initial button clicked on the grid page, returning focus to it upon modal dismissal regardless of how many in-modal steps occurred.

column1: How does CSS min-height: 38px and touch-action: manipulation benefit mobile touch targets on navigation buttons?
column2: It provides a comfortable tap surface and prevents accidental double-tap zoom delays on mobile browsers.

column1: What CSS property prevents click events from triggering on disabled navigation buttons?
column2: pointer-events: none (combined with the HTML disabled attribute).

column1: Why is it beneficial to separate getFilteredProjects() into a dedicated helper function?
column2: It provides a single source of truth for both portfolio card grid filtering and continuous modal navigation.
